description: ONE CELL, by its id (printed by read_table and search_tables) or by table, row and column: its text, its whole row under the column names, the rows above and below, the cells to its left and right, its table and its act. Ids change when an act is parsed again: search again rather than reuse an old id.

cell.description: The id of the cell, e.g. '19612089'.

column.description: With `table` and `row`: the column, by name or number.

row.description: With `table`: the row number as the answers print it.

table.description: The table, as list_tables or search_tables printed it: 'tabel:14164713.0' (or just 14164713 when the node holds one table).

name: get_cell
